calling_convention.inputs: $fp points to the current 0x100-byte object record

reads: position and velocity words at record offsets 0x0c and 0x10
signed acceleration and time-scale halfwords at offsets 0x3c and 0x40

original.discovery_notes: The type-0x1a per-frame handler at 0x88004e54 calls this routine immediately after 0x88004180. Its live initial state changes velocity 0x000000a0 to 0x000000aa and position 0x00005500 to 0x000055aa. The semantic name describes the verified fixed-point integration without assigning physical units.

commands: flatpak run org.mamedev.MAME kinst -rompath assets/ki1 -debug -nodrc -debugscript mame/oracle_ki15d_8800842c.cmd -video none -sound none -nothrottle -skip_gameinfo -seconds_to_run 4 -cfg_directory work/mame/cfg -diff_directory work/mame/diff
verification.notes: Four controlled R4600 calls cover the live type-0x1a gravity state, a half-rate scale, zero scale, signed controls, and large values that expose 32-bit shift and low-product truncation. The native test compares the complete 1 MiB mapped RAM image after every call.
